title: Pirate Doom II
description: Pirate Doom II is a 32-level partial conversion megawad for Doom II created by Darch. A sequel to Pirate Doom, this swashbuckling adventure expands on its predecessor with a pirate theme featuring more maps, hats, moustaches, and beards. It includes a custom soundtrack composed primarily by Darch, alongside music by Jazz Mickle and tracks from the Monkey Island series.
